purpose: CPU-only cached source volume estimate for one frozen API researcher packet per game; not a source eligibility certification or a paid model run.

selection.policy: Newest recorded eligible version per (game_id, publisher); timestamp ties favor existing notes_v2 text. Deduplicate identical raw SHA or identical text within each game, never across games. HTML API batch SHA is a container and is not an article identity.

caveats: This estimate reads only approved-note metadata, extracted note text, and old immutable source-page caches. No outcomes or raw ESPN responses were loaded; no API calls or downloads occurred.
Qwen token counts are exact for the pinned local tokenizer, not GPT-4.1 billing. Character scenarios (2 to 5 chars/token) are heuristic sensitivity checks, not guaranteed bounds.
All available pages/sections are counted once, using existing plain text for old PDF pages. This does not reproduce the legacy multiple-stage page/question/table/reducer workflow.

The selected source representation still needs source reconstruction, exact raw/text binding, table readability, and eligibility validation before an experiment. Existing old page-cache hashes were checked; canonical new text was not re-extracted or certified against raw bytes.

Publisher modification timestamps, archive capture times, and PDF Last-Modified are different evidence classes; newest metadata is only a sizing convention, not proof that a preferred source is semantically better.
Plain PDF text can lose table alignment; layout-sensitive processing or screenshots can change input volume. Both table-heavy numbers and OCR errors affect provider tokenization.
HTML API files hold multiple articles; api_sha256 alone cannot identify/deduplicate an article. This audit uses per-publisher/game selection and actual extracted text hashes.

Counts exclude instructions, source IDs, line/page markers, JSON/schema overhead, retained transcripts, retries, output, chunk overlap, and any extra reduction pass; wrapper/output scenarios are explicitly stated separately.
The 120k threshold is a hypothetical source-token chunk budget; the actual chosen API model context limit and output reserve determine whether splitting is necessary.
Seasonal research cohort includes games without enough prior numerical history. Counts do not establish the smaller forecast-eligible cohort or a fresh uncontaminated holdout.
